EB.Title: Encounter Builder
EB.Settings.MonsterFolder.Name: Monster folder
EB.Settings.MonsterFolder.Hint: Name of the Actor folder that holds your monsters. All subfolders are included (e.g. Monsters/Monsters/H).
EB.Settings.PartyFolder.Name: Party folder
EB.Settings.PartyFolder.Hint: Name of the Actor folder that holds the player characters (used by the 'Read party' button).
EB.Settings.AbilityBonus.Name: HD bonus per special ability
EB.Settings.AbilityBonus.Hint: Adjusted HD = monster HD + this value for each special ability Item on the monster.
EB.Settings.GroupMult.Name: Use group-size multiplier
EB.Settings.GroupMult.Hint: Large groups count for more than the sum of their HD/XP (x1 for 1, x1.5 for 2, x2 for 3-6, x2.5 for 7-10, x3 for 11-14, x4 for 15+).
EB.Settings.Tiers.Name: Challenge levels
EB.Settings.Tiers.Hint: Comma-separated Name:multiplier pairs. The multiplier is applied to the party budget (total party levels, or XP).
EB.Settings.XPTable.Name: XP budget per character, by level
EB.Settings.XPTable.Hint: Comma-separated XP values for levels 1, 2, 3 ... Used when measuring by XP. Starting values; tune to your table.
EB.Settings.MaxCreatures.Name: Maximum creatures per encounter
EB.Settings.MaxCreatures.Hint: Hard cap on the number of monsters in one encounter.
